# Skids track TRACK3-3. Lines starting with # are comments.

# The picture is track.png: 1024x512, 16 colours. Its palette is the
# track's palette. Colours 8-15 are road (full grip), 0-7 are scenery.
#
# gate x1 y1 x2 y2: lap gates in race order, in world units. Gate 0 is
# the start/finish line; the grid forms up behind it. World to picture:
#   picture x = wx - wy + 512, picture y = (wx + wy) * 31/64 - 252
